text: Given a valid Atera API key, when atera_invoices_list is called, then the result envelope has items/count/page/total_pages/total_items/has_more and items is a list
Given itemsInPage greater than 50, when atera_invoices_list is called, then the page size sent to Atera is capped at 50
Given a real invoice number from a live Atera tenant, when atera_invoice_get is called, then the response contains the invoice's line items
steps: Obtain a live Atera API key for a tenant with at least one invoice
Start the connector locally with that key as X-Atera-Api-Key
Call tools/call atera_invoice_get with a real invoiceNumber from that tenant
expect: Response is the Atera invoice record and includes a non-empty line-items field
notes: needs a real vendor account -- no Atera sandbox is bundled with this repo (see Test strategy S9 in PRD-21196.md)

text: Given Atera returns 404 for an invoice number, when atera_invoice_get is called, then the tool returns {error: not_found}, not an unhandled exception
Given a valid Atera API key, when atera_contracts_list is called, then the result envelope has the standard list shape
Given a real contract id, when atera_contract_get is called, then the full contract record is returned
steps: Obtain a live Atera API key for a tenant with at least one contract
Call tools/call atera_contract_get with a real contractId from that tenant
expect: Response is the Atera contract record (type, customer, dates present)

text: Given a real customer id with at least one contract, when atera_contracts_by_customer is called, then only that customer's contracts are returned
steps: Obtain a live Atera API key for a tenant with 2+ customers, at least one with a contract
Call tools/call atera_contracts_by_customer with the customerId that has a contract
Call it again with a customerId that has none
expect: First call returns that customer's contract(s) only; second call returns an empty items list

text: Given a customer id with zero contracts, when atera_contracts_by_customer is called, then items is an empty list and count is 0, not an error
Given Atera returns 404 for a contract id, when atera_contract_get is called, then the tool returns {error: not_found}
Given Atera returns 404 for a customer id in atera_contracts_by_customer, when the tool is called, then the tool returns {error: not_found}, not an exception
Given a /mcp request with the X-Atera-Api-Key header missing, when any of the five new tools is called, then the gateway responds 401 before any Atera call is attempted
notes: the X-Atera-Api-Key gate is enforced by GatewayCredentialsMiddleware on path prefix /mcp, before any tool dispatch -- it is tool-agnostic by construction, so this existing generic test is the correct evidence for the five new tools too (confirmed by reading server.py:86-91: the path check runs before the JSON-RPC body, including the tool name, is ever parsed).

text: Given Atera itself returns 401/403 for a billing call, when a new tool is called, then the tool returns {error: unauthorized}

Given two concurrent /mcp requests to atera_invoices_list with two different X-Atera-Api-Key values, when both are in flight at once, then each response contains only the data for its own request's key -- no credential or response data crosses between the two concurrent calls
Given the server is created, when atera_navigate(domain=billing) is called, then it returns the five new tool names; when atera_back is called, then billing is among the listed domains
Given the 20 existing tools, when the new tools are added, then test_contract_types.py and the unchanged portion of EXPECTED_TOOLS still pass without modification to any existing entry

Given Atera returns 429 for a billing call, when the tool is called, then the client retries per the existing backoff policy and the eventual error, if retries are exhausted, is {error: rate_limited, retryable: true}
